property_summary: For any admissible setup where the pseudorandom outcome equals 1, a winning-in-mutant play must NOT reset the pot (the reference leaves pot at 10), while the mutant resets pot to 0, breaking the invariant that pot is nonzero after a play whose random value is 1.
change_summary: Change the win condition from random == 0 to random == 1, altering which call outcomes reset the pot.
